units.source_text: 其实他心里完全明白，这不过是自我安慰罢了。

en.t: In truth, he understood perfectly well in his heart that this was nothing more than self-consolation.

units.source_text: 三轮摩托最后的活干完，早在黎明时分就会回去。

en.t: Once the three-wheeled motorcycle had finished its last job, it would have gone back long before daybreak.

units.source_text: 那些家伙们的目的已经再清楚不过了。

en.t: Those people's purpose could not have been any clearer.

units.source_text: 就这样断绝了水的补给，想迫使这头发出点儿声音来吧。

en.t: By cutting off the water supply like this, they meant to force this one to make some kind of sound, no doubt.

units.source_text: 想想看吧，那天自己想把沙坝由下往上弄崩塌，

en.t: Just think of it: that day he had tried to make the sand embankment collapse from the bottom upward,

units.source_text: 那该是多么危险的事呵，

en.t: and how terribly dangerous that must have been,

units.source_text: 可那些家伙明明知道，却默不作声在一旁观看，任你去碰撞。

en.t: yet those people knew it perfectly well and still stood by in silence, watching and letting him crash into it.

units.source_text: 哪可能把他的性命放在心上。

en.t: There was no way they could have cared about his life.

units.source_text: 确实，他们大概不能让知道内情太多的人活着出去，

en.t: Indeed, they probably could not let someone who knew too much about the inside story leave alive,

units.source_text: 要干的话，就打算彻底地干下去吧。

en.t: and if they were going to do it, they intended to carry it through completely.
